who.value: buyer who buys several items from the same seller, often across a live show

stage.value: transaction to fulfilment — basket across orders

job.value: Get several items from one seller into one order with one delivery fee

arrivedFrom.value: Winning lots in a show, My purchases, or a listing from the same seller

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Each direction says it in its own words — 'Your wins … Check out together', 'This order is still open', 'You have an open order with @wuliaotcg'.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Check out together' and 'Add to order' are the filled buttons in their directions; B's 'Browse their store' leads its banner.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Check out together', 'Browse their store' and 'Add to order' each say what happens.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Open order' is explained in place: 'Anything else you buy from @wuliaotcg joins this order until they pack it'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: C asks 'Buy now' vs 'Add to order' and states the consequence ('one S$1.99 delivery fee instead of two').

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each direction adds one compact card; '+1 more' hides extra thumbnails.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Each prompt appears at its own moment — during the show, in My purchases, on the listing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Each prompt is one or two short lines plus a clear button.
